title: GirSociety Client v2.6.5 — Prestige Codex OSRS Wiki Categories
name: GirSociety Standalone Client (Rev 240)
changelog:
### 🏛️ Prestige Codex OSRS Wiki Categories Alignment
* **Wiki Categorization**: Reorganized all skills into the 4 official OSRS skill categories: Combat, Gathering, Production, and Utility.
* **Clean Tab Layout**: Removed the redundant 'All Skills' tab to give full visual prominence to the 4 categories.
* **Category Balancing**: Renamed Artisan to Production, and moved Construction and Firemaking to Utility in alignment with OSRS standards.
